patternStatus: No APG pattern names a dual list. Read on 2026-09-24: the Listboxes with Rearrangeable Options example, whose second example is a multi-select dual list with Add and Remove, supplies the move keys, aria-keyshortcuts, the focus destination after a move and the live confirmation. Each list is the listbox family, whose own transcription of the Listbox pattern stands.
reference: Ant Design Transfer, PrimeNG PickList, Kendo UI for Angular ListBox (connectedWith), Salesforce lightning-dual-listbox, PatternFly DualListSelector, MUI Transfer List, APG Listboxes with Rearrangeable Options
engine: @slotted/core/collection createFilter for the search; @slotted/core/drag for the drag between and within panes; @slotted/core/live-announcer for the move; @slotted/core/state for the four models
rootRole: group, named by the consumer's aria-label or aria-labelledby, or by the field around it

roles.list: the listbox family: role=listbox, aria-multiselectable=true, aria-labelledby the pane's title
roles.switch: the segmented-control family: radiogroup, aria-label messages.panes

anatomy.root: a div carrying data-ui=transfer, data-layout, data-size and data-pane, the side the switch names; role=group; the container named transfer that the narrow layout is decided in
anatomy.switch: a div around the segmented-control family with one item per pane, each reading messages.paneCount; rendered always, laid out only in steps
anatomy.body: the grid of the two panes and the actions column; one element in from the root, so the container query on the root can change its tracks
anatomy.pane: one per side: data-side=source or target, data-current on the pane the switch names; role=group named by its title; the drag container of its side
anatomy.pane-header: the row above the search: select-all, title and count
anatomy.select-all: a span around the checkbox family, whose own root part the checkbox stylesheet keys on; tri-state over the pane's visible enabled items: checked when all are selected, indeterminate when some are; aria-label messages.selectAll
anatomy.title: the pane's name, messages.source or messages.target; names the pane and its list
anatomy.count: messages.count, messages.countSelected or messages.countFiltered, whichever the pane's state asks for
anatomy.search: a div around the text-field family at the family's size step less one, type=search, named by messages.search; absent when searchable is false
anatomy.search-icon: the search glyph the family draws in the text field's start slot
anatomy.list: a div around the pane's listbox: plain variant, selectionMode multiple, rows options tall; the box the drop indicator is positioned in
anatomy.empty: the content of the listbox's own empty part: the inbox glyph and messages.empty, or the search-x glyph and messages.noResults while a query is typed
anatomy.drop-indicator: a line of no height inside the list, at --_drop-offset from its top, while a pointer drag hovers a valid position; aria-hidden
anatomy.pane-footer: the consumer's content under the list, per side; absent when the consumer gives none
anatomy.actions: the column between the panes: a group of the four move buttons, then reorder; in steps it stands under the current pane and shows only that pane's two moves
anatomy.move-to-target: a button: the chevron toward the target and messages.moveToTarget; asks to move the source's selected enabled items; aria-keyshortcuts Enter; disabled while none is selected
anatomy.move-all-to-target: a button: the double chevron and messages.moveAllToTarget; asks to move every visible enabled source item
anatomy.move-to-source: a button: the chevron toward the source and messages.moveToSource; aria-keyshortcuts Delete
anatomy.move-all-to-source: a button: the double chevron toward the source and messages.moveAllToSource
anatomy.reorder: a group of move-up and move-down under the move buttons; rendered only when reorderable
anatomy.move-up: a button: the chevron up and messages.moveUp; asks to move the target's selected items one place toward the start; aria-keyshortcuts Alt+ArrowUp
anatomy.move-down: a button: the chevron down and messages.moveDown; aria-keyshortcuts Alt+ArrowDown

wiring.aria-labelledby: on each pane and on its listbox, naming the pane's title
wiring.aria-label: on the actions group, on the reorder group, on the select-all checkbox and on the search field, from messages
wiring.aria-keyshortcuts: on move-to-target (Enter), move-to-source (Delete), move-up (Alt+ArrowUp) and move-down (Alt+ArrowDown), which is how the APG example says the shortcuts exist
wiring.aria-disabled: on a move button with nothing to move: the button family's focusableWhenDisabled, so the button that just emptied its own selection keeps focus
wiring.aria-invalid / aria-required: on both listboxes, from invalid and required
wiring.live: every move is announced politely through the shared live announcer: messages.moved

request.targetKeys: ChangeRequest<readonly string[]> & { direction, keys }: direction is target, source or reorder; keys are the keys that moved, in the order they moved
request.selectedKeys: ChangeRequest<readonly string[]>: one set across both panes; each pane's selection is the set less the other pane's keys
request.moveClearsSelection: the keys a move carried leave the selection in the same gesture, with the move's reason, so the selection request follows the targetKeys request
request.equal: a request for a value equal to the current one is not emitted

rules.collection: items is the whole collection, both sides; the scope paragraph's sourceItems. A key of targetKeys with no item is drawn with the key as its label and data-unresolved, never dropped, because dropping it would change a form's value without a request
rules.order: without reorderable the target is drawn in the order of items and a move asks for keys in that order; with it the target is drawn in the order of targetKeys, moved keys join the end in the order of items, or the position a drag drops them at
rules.disabled: a disabled item cannot be selected or moved and stays in the pane it is in; move-all skips it
rules.moveAll: moves the pane's visible enabled items, so under a query only what the reader sees
rules.selectAll: the checkbox selects or clears the pane's visible enabled items and leaves the rest of the selection alone, with the reason select
rules.search: createFilter contains, at base sensitivity in the locale, over the label and the description; filter replaces it and receives the side
rules.focus: after a move the pane's listbox keeps focus and its own removal rule picks the active option; a pane left with no option while it held focus hands focus to the other pane's listbox
rules.drag: one @slotted/core/drag container per pane. A dragged item carries its pane's selection when it is selected, and itself otherwise. Across panes it moves; within the target it reorders, only under reorderable; within the source every position is refused
rules.steps: under layout steps, or under auto below 36rem of the root's inline size, the switch chooses the pane that is shown; the other pane leaves the layout and actions shows the current pane's two moves under it
rules.reorder: move-up, move-down, Alt+ArrowUp and Alt+ArrowDown and a drag within the target are off while a target query is typed, because a place in a subset is not a place in the list
rules.readOnly: both lists stay reachable and selectable; no move, drag or reorder is asked for, and the move buttons are aria-disabled

itemAttributes.where: on the option's indicator, which the family draws in every option: the listbox draws the option itself from items, and the stylesheet reads the mark with :has()

keyboard.effect: native order: switch, then per pane select-all, search and list, with the actions between the panes

keyboard.key: Arrows, Home, End, PageUp, PageDown, Space, Shift+Space, Control+A, printable characters
keyboard.effect: the listbox family's own keyboard, unchanged, inside each pane
in either list: moves the pane's selected enabled items to the other pane, or the active option when none is selected
keyboard.focus: stays in the list; the active option becomes the next one still present

keyboard.effect: in the target list: moves to the source under the same rule
in either list: moves toward the pane at the inline end, the target in a left-to-right document; mirrored in right-to-left
in either list: moves toward the pane at the inline start
in the target list under reorderable: moves the selected items, or the active option, one place
during a pointer drag: cancels it, taken by the drag module in the capture phase

Enter.reason: The APG dual-list example gives Enter to Add, and it is the one key that moves without a modifier.
Enter.cost: Inside transfer, Enter no longer toggles an option as the listbox family's own departure makes it; Space does.

toolbar.reason: The APG's first example groups four action buttons as one toolbar tab stop. Here every move has a shortcut in the list, so the buttons are the pointer's and the discoverable path, and a toolbar would hide five of the six behind arrow keys.
toolbar.cost: Up to six tab stops between the panes.

tree.reason: Ant's Tree Transfer and PatternFly's isTree put a tree in the source pane. A tree's selection is by node with cascade rules; hierarchical-picker in wave 11 owns selection in a tree.

table.composition: renderItem with the listbox family's meta part for a short second column
table.reason: Only Ant ships a table inside a pane.

oneWay.composition: move-to-source removes an item from the target
oneWay.reason: Only Ant ships a single-direction style.

minMax.composition: invalid={targetKeys.length > max}, with the message in the field around it
minMax.reason: Only Salesforce ships min and max; the family owns required, and the Angular Validator reports it.

pagination.composition: virtual and itemSize, handed to each listbox
pagination.reason: A windowed pane has no pages to turn, and Ant's pagination cannot be combined with its own render props.

moveAllShortcut.reason: Only Kendo binds move-all to Control+Shift+Arrow.

--slotted-transfer-pane-min-inline-size.reason: The narrowest pane an option of two words, its check and a count still fit in at md; no scale holds a width of a column, and the 36rem container step is two of it plus the actions column and two gaps.
